rules.statement: A mortgage decree requires registration, and a deed executed and registered prior to the mortgage decree takes precedence over a subsequent Fiscal's transfer based on that unregistered mortgage decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "As pointed out by the Supreme. Court in Saravanamuttu v. Solamuttu [1 26 N. L.R. 385.] and Adappa Chetty v. Babi ,[2 25 N. L. R. 284.] a mortgage decree requires registration."
